question: Only change restitution for the velocity-enabled 2026-09-16 Flat Leg AMP-ROA policy

definitions.derivatives: finite differences at 50Hz within each window; omit done samples and reset boundaries

limitations: One evaluation seed and one trained checkpoint; no statistical generalization.
Restitution sampled per collision shape in startup event. Material draw values and foot contact signals are not recorded.
No foot-contact force, contact-point normal velocity or bounce-event telemetry; root vertical motion is not proof of foot bounce or crossing bounce threshold.
Control rollout samples first recorded after a physics step; initial-impact effects cannot be separated from later foot-ground effects.
Reduced evaluation restitution does not establish that retraining with a narrower range improves hardware behavior.
findings: Baseline replay samples exactly match all three prior pure-plane scenarios.
Changing restitution does not consistently reduce steady roll/pitch angular velocity RMS; all relative changes are within about 2.1 percent in this seed.
Mean right-turn roll becomes more negative after lowering restitution.
Forward-right left-foot peak joint speed drops from 15.107 to 10.053 / 10.015 rad/s over the full 20-second windows; residual slight configured-limit exceedances remain.
This evidence supports restitution sensitivity of isolated joint-speed extremes but not restitution as the main explanation for steady body posture fluctuation.
Fixed zero restitution increases the forward-left startup attitude excursion; inspect full-episode peaks rather than steady window alone.
